Mikael '''"Mitzu_Kniven"''' Sellberg, also known as {{Player|U:Prey|flag=se|link=false}}, started playing in [[1996]] and played mostly [[CTF]] until [[2002]] when he started out in [[Nii!]] and then went on to [[U:Clan]]. Used to play defensive positions.

Continued playing Q3 RA and some Quake Champions. Later on, in [[2024]], he realized that there's still an active CTF Community, jumped onboard and started playing again in june the same year.
